summary: We are looking for a highly motivated fresher with strong knowledge in Java and Spring Boot to join our backend development team.
responsibilities: Develop, test, and maintain backend services using Java and Spring Boot.
Work with relational databases such as MySQL/PostgreSQL for data storage and retrieval.
Collaborate with senior developers to understand requirements and deliver scalable solutions.
Participate in code reviews and follow best practices for clean, maintainable code.
required_skills: Strong understanding of Core Java, OOPs concepts, Collections, Exception Handling, and Multithreading basics.
Hands-on knowledge of Spring Boot, REST API development, and dependency injection.
Basic understanding of SQL queries, Joins, and database concepts.
Knowledge of Git/GitHub for version control.
nice_to_have_skills: Exposure to cloud platforms like AWS / Azure.
